title: iOS tap-event handler regression in shared UI kit
text: A regression in the shared UI kit's tap-event handler stops touch events propagating to buttons rendered inside a modal sheet on iOS 16 and iOS 17. This is the underlying cause of PF-104. Android is unaffected because it uses a different gesture recognizer.

title: Payment Confirmation Button Unresponsive on iOS
text: On iOS 16 and iOS 17 the confirm payment button does not respond to tap events on the payment confirmation screen. Affects 100% of iOS users attempting to complete a payment. PF-104 itself is blocked by PF-098. This is a release blocker for v2.4.

title: Duplicate Transaction Created on Network Retry
text: When a payment request times out and the client retries, a duplicate transaction is sometimes created. Engineering is implementing idempotency keys to resolve this. This is a release blocker for v2.4.

title: Payment history timeout for large accounts
text: Accounts with more than 50,000 transactions time out when loading the payment history view. Open and HIGH priority in Sprint 15, but explicitly NOT listed as a release blocker for v2.4.

title: Release Condition — v2.4 payment release
text: The v2.4 payment release cannot proceed until both PF-104 and PF-105 are fully resolved, and a full regression pass is completed. PF-106 is open but is not a blocker for this release.

title: Freeze card toggle missing accessibility label
text: The freeze card toggle on the card management screen has no accessibility label, so VoiceOver announces it as 'button'. Design reference is FG-012.

title: Biometric login prompt shown twice after app upgrade
text: After upgrading from v2.2 to v2.3 the biometric login prompt appeared twice on first launch. Resolved by clearing the stale keychain migration flag. Shipped in v2.3.1.
